_about: Template for the Milestone 03 report generator. Arrays are empty on purpose: real rows come from export_workbook_to_json.py (or are typed by hand) after real sessions. Keys that start with an underscore are documentation and must be ignored by readers. Never fill this file with invented data.

_value_notes.success: one of Success, Partial, Fail (Success rate = Success / attempts)
_value_notes.time_s: seconds, filled for Success attempts only, otherwise null
_value_notes.errors: whole number >= 0 counted by the observer
_value_notes.sus.items: ten answers 1 to 5 in statement order Q1 to Q10; score = ((Q1+Q3+Q5+Q7+Q9) - 5 + 25 - (Q2+Q4+Q6+Q8+Q10)) * 2.5
_value_notes.severity: High, Medium or Low (M02 report Table 13)
_value_notes.interface: screen code and name, for example 'C5 Pick a time'
_value_notes.required fields for the generator: participants[].code, tasks[].id, tasks[].results[].participant/success/time_s/errors/seq, sus[].participant/items, issues[].id/interface/issue/severity/fix/status. hints, note and the other issue fields are optional extras.
